name: Attack on Titan (Shingeki no Kyojin)
tagline: Humanity's last stand against the Titans
description: In a world where humanity lives inside cities surrounded by enormous walls due to the Titans, gigantic humanoid creatures who devour humans seemingly without reason, Eren Yeager vows to eliminate the Titans after one of them destroys his hometown and kills his mother. A dark fantasy masterpiece that redefined the shonen genre with its complex plot and moral ambiguity.
cons: Heavy themes may not suit all viewers
